item.title: Fallen Tree Branch in Park, 20th July
item.description:
The Small Park located between the rear of Pound Farm Courtyard and Ermin Street. The fallen tree branch came down this week and is blocking the footpath in the park. In addition, the tree looks to be dead as it has had no leaves for a while. This could also be a potential hazard in the winter with high winds, due to its proximity to several houses

item.title: More flytipping, 20th July
item.description:
Photos are from today, after bin collections..this is the public pavement outside 15 and 16 Granville Street. First report was filed with the wrong place. Apparently this needs to go to highways not housing. There are flies, it smells, it's antisocial, it's a trip hazard (I have moved things out of the way several times) and it gets worse day by day. It seems the longer it is left, the more people think it's acceptable and keep adding to it!

Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): 13, Granville Street, Wymans Brook, Cheltenham, Cheltenham
Report on FixMyStreet
